description: Sri Lanka Customs  -  Rates of Exchange Effective from 15.07.2019 to 21.07.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework under the Customs Ordinance. It establishes compliance requirements for import/export transactions and rescinds previous rates, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter.
